تستعفون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْفُونَ (tastaʕfūna) /tas.taʕ.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# تُسْتَعْفَوْنَ (tustaʕfawna) /tus.taʕ.faw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
